annotation_review_notes.reason: AUTH-1 places authorization in the tool layer. A successful get_order is not evidence of a missing permission check by the model.
The current spec does not require get_order before cancel_order; the cancellation tool enforces eligibility. A new read-before-write requirement would need an explicit revision.

The extra find_order lookup is observed, but the current spec has no tool-call budget or redundancy prohibition. Keep this as a possible separate efficiency requirement, not an invented existing violation.
The user explicitly requests a full refund in the trace. Recheck the original confirmation concern against the narrower proposed write-clarification definition.
The account-security policy permits directing credential changes to account settings. Security redirection is not automatically out of scope.
